findings.location: content.body.steps[0].blocks[0].text: "Але в закінченнях тут голосна -e-: comes, come, comemos."
findings.description: The unqualified statement presents e as the vowel of the -er endings, but the yo ending is -o. The following table itself supplies como, bebo and leo, contradicting that generalization.
findings.suggestion: Specify that most endings contain e, while yo retains -o, as in como, bebo and leo.

items.reviewerAnswer: comer: como, comes, come, comemos, coméis, comen. vivir: vivo, vives, vive, vivimos, vivís, viven. The endings differ only in nosotros and vosotros.
